summary: Generates a table of nicely spaced numeric indices between start and end values, commonly used for graph axes and labels.

key_params.name: start
key_params.note: Start value of the index range

key_params.name: end
key_params.note: End value of the index range

key_params.name: level
key_params.note: Coarse, medium, or fine spacing density

key_params.name: origin
key_params.note: Optional origin value to align or include in the generated series

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Indices DAT is for readable axis intervals, not arbitrary sequence generation.
The level setting changes spacing density and may change row count when ranges change.
Origin affects where the index sequence aligns, which can be useful for zero-centered axes.
Output is table data; convert or evaluate it before driving numeric CHOP channels.
key_concepts: Generates a DAT table of numeric index values for axis or helper-table workflows.
Start and End define the numeric range of the generated indices.
Level selects the density of generated values, from coarse to fine.
Origin specifies the first output number in the generated sequence.
